title: Quarterly Remittance Return of Creditable Income Taxes Withheld (Expanded)

choice_rows.label: If over-remittance, mark one:
options: To be issued a Tax Credit Certificate
To be carried over to the next quarter

atc.label: Add an ATC (search by code or nature of payment)

validation.how: Messages go into a Needs review section below the Part II totals (first 20 only); fields only turn their label red, and Queue for submission is disabled while any error exists.

findings.now: Choosing No removes every ATC row at once with no warning, even when several ATCs were entered.
findings.why: set_any_tax_withheld(false) empties the schedule (form_1601eq.rs:828-835), and the official page asks first with 'You are about to change the value . Doing this will clear all computation fields Do you wish to proceed?' (rule 1601eq-change-004), which the desktop never shows.

options.name: Official confirm
options.detail: Show the official confirmation text and clear only on Yes, leaving the rows in place on No.

options.name: Undo bar
options.detail: Clear as now but keep the removed rows in a one-step Undo bar.

findings.now: Switching between Private and Government silently removes every selected ATC row.
findings.why: set_category empties the schedule (form_1601eq.rs:837-844), and the official page warns 'By changing Category your selected ATC will be remove.' (rule 1601eq-change-002), which the desktop never shows.

options.name: Official warning
options.detail: Show the official sentence and clear the rows only after the user confirms.

options.name: Keep valid rows
options.detail: Keep rows whose ATC exists in the new list, drop the rest, and say which were dropped.

findings.now: The year can be retyped on a return opened from a tile, and saving then stores it under that other year, so the tile's own draft stops updating.
findings.why: The year is part of the storage key (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:144-154), so a changed year creates a second draft row while the tile keeps the original.

options.name: Read-only year
options.detail: Show the tile's year as text, since the library tile already fixes the period.

options.name: Guarded edit
options.detail: Allow a change only through the tile picker, with a message that it opens a different return.

findings.now: Print preview draws the January 2019 sheet, so the printed item numbers differ from the January 2018 items on the page.
findings.why: The sheet slug is 1601eq-2019 (form_1601eq_view.rs:1100), and the rules warn that the 2019 guide has shifted numbering that must not be merged into the 2018 rules (rules/forms/1601eq-v2018/HANDOFF.md:32).

options.name: Label the preview
options.detail: Show 'This preview uses the January 2019 sheet' in the status message beside the preview.

options.name: Add a 2018 sheet
options.detail: Build and register a January 2018 frozen sheet with its own key map before printing.

findings.now: Errors appear in a Needs review block below the totals, so the user must scroll to find them, and only the first 20 show.
findings.why: The list is cut with take(20) (form_1601eq_view.rs:1133) and drawn last (1249-1251), fields only turn their label red (381-394), and the official success alert is never shown because there is no Validate step.

options.name: Panel under toolbar
options.detail: Pin the Needs review list above the scrolling body so it stays visible while editing.

options.name: Inline messages
options.detail: Show each message under its own field, keyed by the error field names the model returns.

findings.now: One click queues the return for background submission, with no internet or email reminder and no confirmation.
findings.why: The official alert 'Please ensure that you have INTERNET access and a VALID email address is indicated in your tax return.' with 'Are you sure you want to submit?' (rule 1601eq-final-001) is never shown before mark_submitted queues the draft.

options.name: Official confirm
options.detail: Show the full official text with Yes and No, and queue only on Yes.

options.name: Email line
options.detail: Keep one click but show the email address that will receive the receipt next to the button before queueing.

findings.field: Add an ATC (search by code or nature of payment)
findings.now: Up to 12 outline buttons, one per matching ATC, fill the page under the Search ATC box, and anything beyond shows as 'N more' text.
findings.why: With 111 options, each pick is a full-width button rather than one line of a searchable multi-select.

options.name: Multi-select combobox
options.detail: A combobox that searches code and description and shows each pick as a removable chip.

options.name: Dropdown list
options.detail: A dropdown under the search box that lists the matches in one scroll area and closes after each pick.

findings.now: The 1601EQ registry entry now claims render contract and HTML components, and the same branch edited shared queue and XML files for this form.
findings.why: Commit 4491832d added four capability flags and a 63-to-1023 mask change for 1601EQ, and abd245d1 touched shared official_xml.rs and queueable.rs, which goes beyond one-line registrations.

options.name: Split registry edits
options.detail: Keep one registration line per form and put capability flags in a separate reviewed commit with the preview evidence.

options.name: Revert shared edits
options.detail: Move the shared official_xml.rs and queueable.rs changes into form-local code.

findings.now: Item 11 appears after Item 12 (email) and the line of business, although the official sheet puts it before the email.
findings.why: render_part_one adds the category row after the field grid (form_1601eq_view.rs:600-627), while the official layout has CatAgent_P before txtEmail (1601eq-v2018.json entries 21 and 23).

options.name: Move row
options.detail: Place the category row between Items 9A and 10 and Item 12 in the grid.

options.name: Accept order
options.detail: Keep the current order and record it as a deliberate layout choice.
